name: ctx
description: Context window details like the Desktop app's panel: /ctx opens a pane that docks beside the transcript, and a 📊 button above the prompt toggles it.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: follow uses Agent-Pulse's palette (ember when it is not installed); ember is Claude's warm orange range and neon bioluminescent sea colors, both shading the bar's categories and drawing its free space as water; claude and mono keep the engine's category colors and dotted free space, as before 0.8

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: follow uses Agent-Pulse's level (subtle when it is not installed); off keeps everything still; subtle laps the water's edge, glows what a turn added and breathes near auto-compact; full also lets the water drift and sweeps a wave back in when a compaction frees room
